experiment: AntMaze V6 one-step ETT, Step 3a: full-length rollout diagnostic vs the held-out simulator branches (distributional), advice C (simulator teacher) vs A (memoryless nominal)
status: oracle-supervised engineering stage; nothing downstream generated
anchors: 2000 held-out anchors per fold, uniform over anchors, seed 201000000; strata = anchor region
continuation: start agent mode (the reference branches' continuation); first query = the logged torque
termination: reach (|xy - goal| <= 0.5), horizon 800 - t, onset (exact hazard integration along the path; no recovery)

advice.C: simulator teacher along the model path under the branch's redrawn timetable (Step 0 / 1 construction)
advice.A: memoryless nominal a_b ~ MDN(s) fitted on the d05 log (k 5, (256, 256), 20000 steps, seed 0; fixed final iterate), K = 4 sampled advice paths per anchor, seed 202000000

comparison.rates: death / reach / timeout / entered-far: model mean of exact per-anchor probabilities vs the branches' realised rates
comparison.distributions: death time (steps after the anchor), death x, time to reach: weighted two-sample KS vs the branches' realised values
comparison.discrimination: AUROC of the per-anchor P(death) against the realised branch death (reported, not gated)

gate_rule: every rate gap and KS within threshold on the pooled sample and in every stratum with >= min_stratum_anchors anchors; evaluated separately for C and A

reading.C_fails: fix the motion / onset model first
reading.C_passes_A_fails: the advice process is the bottleneck; a latched nominal from the visible history is the next candidate
reading.both_pass: the protocol nominal suffices for the futures
